where: blaze: the no-op lane and files read off the disk (base-db IncludedFile)
what: A build that looked at any path no watch covers is never answered again without a walk, and `IncludedFile::content_now` looked at the disk on every ask: reth walks 5,305 units (2 s) every build for `rustix-1.1.5/src/backend/mod.rs` (a `#[path]` candidate that is not there); a serde fixture for serde_core's `out/private.rs`; on NixOS a hello-world for glibc's `crtn.o`.
cost: the no-op lane (milliseconds) answers no real project
cause: the included-file reads had no vouching, only the build scripts' traced reads had
whys: why a walk: the lane refuses
why: the last build looked at a path on the disk
why: an included file is read on every ask
why: its reads were never given the watches the usercode inputs have
property: two homes for `a file outside every view`, one watched and one not
class: one concept in two homes, only one of them finished (rule one-concept-one-home)
prevention: built (9b5c8217a5): content_now wants the file's directory watched and keeps the answer with the watches' generation; a serde fixture's fourth build is answered in 34 ms on the Mac. Not built: crtn.o (the native layouts' look, serve/native.rs) and a test under the simulated watches
